explanation: The "bg" clip whose width gives the joystick reach (get_width()/20*0.5 stored into unk_0c/unk_10) is resolved with the wrong search context: the original DepthSearches from DebugCachedCharacter::GetChar(v131), where v131 is bound to HUDControls +0x4c (m_joystick, "HUDelements.controls.controls.Joystick") at recovered/native/hexrays-all/chunk_012.c:12575 and used at chunk_012.c:12757, while the reconstruction searches from m_currentRoot (+0x388, "_root.menu_HUD_<style>"). Find(name, context) is a DepthSearch from that context (RenderFX.hpp:185, 0x7a8a84), so the reconstructed lookup can select a different "bg" elsewhere under the HUD root or return null and dereference it at line 514; severity medium because the two subtrees may still contain the same single "bg".
